paragraphs.text: We are of your kindred and closely related to you.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: That is, taking the Lord to witness: for the ark was still in Abinadab's house.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: The children of God called idols blind and lame guides: therefore the Jebusites meant that they should prove that their gods were neither blind nor lame.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: The idols should no longer enter into that place.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: He built from the town house round about to his own house 1Ch 11:8.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: Meaning the valley of giants, which David called Baalperazim, because of his victory.
paragraphs.label: g

paragraphs.text: Which was in the tribe of Benjamin, but the Philistines possessed it.
paragraphs.label: h
